problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: weight 60 tons
* Shipment Beta: weight 65 tons
* Shipment Gamma: weight 57 tons
* Shipment Delta: weight 63 tons
* Shipment Epsilon: weight 34 tons
* Shipment Zeta: weight 44 tons
* Shipment Eta: weight 39 tons
* Shipment Theta: weight 55 tons
* Shipment Iota: weight 62 tons
* Shipment Kappa: weight 50 tons
* Shipment Lambda: weight 39 tons
* Shipment Mu: weight 34 tons
* Shipment Nu: weight 39 tons
* Shipment Xi: weight 39 tons
* Shipment Omicron: weight 32 tons
* Shipment Pi: weight 54 tons
* Shipment Rho: weight 66 tons
* Shipment Sigma: weight 37 tons
* Shipment Tau: weight 34 tons
* Shipment Upsilon: weight 63 tons
* Shipment Phi: weight 47 tons
* Shipment Chi: weight 66 tons
* Shipment Psi: weight 49 tons
* Shipment Omega: weight 52 tons
* Shipment Zeta Prime: weight 60 tons

Each cargo plane has a maximum payload capacity of 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total weight loaded onto any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
